summary: APPROVED. The target freezes Praxis issue 166 and the exact tracked task path; the loader, launcher and preflight compare the complete five-field identity, while detached execution retains exact-HEAD and clean-worktree gates. Qualification performs an isolated 21-step MJPC static-state planning rollout without advancing the external plant (plant_time_s=0); preparation and offline verification forbid plant integration and report zero steps. Explicit authorization binds the exact head, protocol hash, prepared manifest and two-attempt budget. Capture retains one permanent ledger, no retry and first-nonpass stop. The frozen protocol hash matches, preserving its scientific thresholds.
